I've trusted Dr. Ajarn for almost 21 years.
Both my mother and I have been treating my child since kindergarten until he's employed.
We've had dental scaling, extractions, dental implants, and dentures (in the future, braces are a difficult option).
The doctor offers a comprehensive treatment plan, tailored to our dental condition and underlying conditions. He answers questions without being pushy or demanding. He doesn't push or force us. Patients are ready to receive treatment. It's truly rare to find a doctor with professional ethics. The price may be slightly higher than other clinics, but it's worth it. Try it yourself. You have to call to make an appointment.
The doctor is extremely experienced. He explains all the risks.

I recently had my wisdom teeth removed. I was considering having it done near my home, but I didn't dare take the risk. In the end, I decided to travel a bit farther, but I felt comfortable and confident. Every clinic I asked about said "surgery only."
But the doctor said, "Try extraction first. If it doesn't work, then surgery."

I personally work in the medical field. It reduces the risk of infection and costs for patients. Sharing my personal experience.
